## Executive Summary
EN: AI Router Full Corpus (GLOBAL ref baseline) top 3: openai/gpt-6-luna / google/gemini-3-flash / deepseek/deepseek-v4-1-flash. Peak value: openai/gpt-6-luna (507.8/$). Fork alert: openai/gpt-6-2-astra flags ref latency degradation; meta-llama/llama-4-maverick-400b is a high-value sleeper (unmeasured baseline).
ZH: AI 模型路由全量语料（GLOBAL 参考基线）前三：openai/gpt-6-luna / google/gemini-3-flash / deepseek/deepseek-v4-1-flash；峰值标价性价比 openai/gpt-6-luna（507.8/$）。分叉预警：openai/gpt-6-2-astra 属高基准参考延迟退化，meta-llama/llama-4-maverick-400b 属高性价比黑马（非实时遥测）。

## Evaluation Methodology
- Confidence Decay: 90-day half-life exponential decay anchored to snapshot verification timestamps.
- Blended Net Cost: 0.8 * promptUsdPer1m + 0.2 * completionUsdPer1m (4 decimal places).
- Value Lift per Dollar: benchmarkScore / max(0.05, blendedNetUsd).
- Manifold Score: Riemannian weighted combination of value lift, TTFT/TPS latency, benchmark score, regional reachability, and fail-closed ZDR compliance.
- Paraconsistent Forks: CONVERGENT_LEADER, PRODUCTION_WORKHORSE, LATENCY_DEGRADED_WARNING, HIGH_VALUE_SLEEPER.

## Benchmark Suites
- SWE-bench Verified (swe-bench-verified · 500 tasks · % Resolved): https://myrilum.com/router/benchmarks/swe-bench-verified — 500 human-validated open-source issue tasks measuring multi-file patch synthesis and regression verification.
- LiveCodeBench v5 (livecodebench-v5 · 880 tasks · % Pass@1): https://myrilum.com/router/benchmarks/livecodebench-v5 — Continuously refreshed competitive programming benchmark guarding against training-set contamination.
- AIME 2026 Reasoning (aime-2026-reasoning · 120 tasks · % Exact Match): https://myrilum.com/router/benchmarks/aime-2026-reasoning — High-difficulty zero-tool mathematical reasoning benchmark evaluating symbolic deduction and proof rigor.
- BFCL v3 Tool Calling (bfcl-v3-tool-calling · 1400 tasks · % AST Match): https://myrilum.com/router/benchmarks/bfcl-v3-tool-calling — Verifies parallel function dispatch, multi-turn argument repair, strict JSON Schema, and irrelevance detection.
- MMMU Multimodal Vision (mmmu-multimodal · 900 tasks · % Accuracy): https://myrilum.com/router/benchmarks/mmmu-multimodal — Cross-disciplinary multimodal evaluation covering engineering diagrams, table OCR, charts, and GUI layouts.
- MRCR 256K+ Long Context (mrcr-long-context · 400 tasks · % Multi-Needle): https://myrilum.com/router/benchmarks/mrcr-long-context — Multi-needle retrieval and conflict resolution over 128K-2M context windows measuring attention decay.
